description: Optional line customization: sets the business name and greeting Kai answers with, as the owner requested. Not required to make calls, and never changes payment, usage or fraud limits. Extra business details are optional; no business-qualification questionnaire is needed. An existing business greeting is left unchanged.

business_id.description: The account to set up. Optional when the token reaches one account.

website.description: The business's website, if it has one.

what_you_sell.description: What the business sells or does, in the owner's words.

who_kai_will_call.description: Who the owner wants Kai to call, e.g. other businesses, existing customers, or people who asked for a callback.

name: set_up_business
title: Customize Business Line
